description: Repeat-use: records an endpoint's 402 state (status, payable, payTo, amount, network, in_spec) and returns exactly what changed since your previous call. First call records a baseline; call again later for a delta. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/x402-preflight/monitor
